name: drive_copy
title: Copy File
description: Copy a OneDrive file or folder to another folder. Copying runs in the background: this returns an operation_id to check with m365_get(resource='operation').

account_id.description: Account ID or email address. Omit when only one account is signed in.

destination_path.description: Destination folder path instead of destination_id.

new_name.description: Name for the copy (default: same name).

summary.description: One-line human summary. The tool's text content is this result serialized as JSON (summary included), so a client that ignores structuredContent still sees every field.

graph_calls: POST /me/drive/items/{id}/copy {parentReference, name} → 202 + Location monitor URL (stored server-side for 24 hours)

validation_rules.rule: Exactly one of destination_id or destination_path.
validation_rules.error: Invalid destination_path: cannot be combined with destination_id

output.summary: Copy started; check with m365_get(resource='operation', id='op_7f3c2a').
